summary: Frontend-only retest of WorkfloW via public preview URL (1920x800). BOTH reported bug fixes VERIFIED WORKING. (1) AI integration: /ai-api/chat now streams real Claude Opus 5 answers via Emergent LLM key — curl POST {sessionId,text} returned 'data: {"t":"d","x":"Привет!"}' + '{"t":"end"}'; in UI the answer streams into the thread with latency metrics (3374 ms / 2458 ms / 2912 ms) and NO 'AI_PROXY_URL / EMERGENT_LLM_KEY не заданы в .env' error; [data-testid=ai-error-note] never appeared. (2) Empty-state composer: on a fresh load with no session, chat-input accepts text (value='Скажи привет одним словом'), chat-send-btn becomes enabled, sending creates a new session (rail shows it, title from first message) and the model answers. Regression PASS: second message in the same thread answered; 'Переспросить' (regenerate) produced a new answer; 'Изменить' -> edit -> 'Переспросить' resent the edited query and got a matching answer ('пёс'); history persisted across full page reload; sidebar navigation across all 5 sections works; AI-центр panel opens/closes. Zero console errors, zero pageerrors, zero HTTP >=400 (no blocked /_next/static/*) across 4 runs.

ui_bugs.issue: After editing a query, the bubble keeps showing the OLD formulation while the branch counter reads 1/2 and the AI answer below corresponds to the NEW formulation — mismatched query/answer pair. Root cause: `const [idx, setIdx] = useState(variants.length - 1)` (line 20) is initialised once; when a new variant is appended idx stays at the previous index (no effect/sync on variants.length). Fix: sync idx to variants.length-1 when variants grow.

LOW (carried over from iteration_8, not a blocker): answers are authored as 'ЛОКАЛЬНАЯ МОДЕЛЬ' while they actually come from cloud Claude Opus 5; topbar says 'QWEN 2.5 7B · ОФЛАЙН', status bar 'ЛОКАЛЬНЫЙ РЕЖИМ', header/footer say Claude Opus 5 · облако Emergent. Misleading privacy signal for the user.

action_items: Fix stale variant index in components/chat/message-user.tsx:20 so the displayed query switches to the newly edited formulation after 'Переспросить'.

Optional (LOW): make the AI message author label reflect the actual engine (cloud Opus 5 vs local Qwen) instead of the hardcoded 'ЛОКАЛЬНАЯ МОДЕЛЬ'; also the status-bar mode label from iteration_8 is still derived from stats.offline.
critical_code_review_comments: app/ai-api/chat/route.ts still hard-fails when AI_PROXY_URL/EMERGENT_LLM_KEY are absent; /app/.env is not committed-safe — consider a clear in-UI setup hint instead of a raw error string leaking env var names.
route.ts propagates upstream provider errors verbatim to the client (e.g. litellm BadRequestError text was visible when the request body lacked `text`); sanitize before surfacing.
message-user.tsx derives state from props via useState without sync — classic stale-state bug (see MEDIUM issue).

rca_of_the_issue: iteration_8 blockers are resolved: (a) missing /app/.env with AI_PROXY_URL + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — now present, streaming works end to end; (b) composer draft keyed by a null session id — now backed by local freeDraft state (screen-chat.tsx:59/530), verified that typing works in the empty state and the first send creates the session. Newly found MEDIUM defect is unrelated: derived-state initialisation in MessageUser leaves the branch index pointing at the previous formulation after an edit.
